title: Evaluation of a depth-zero tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a decision tree on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube whose outputs are signs in $\{ -1,1\}$. If the depth of $T$ is zero, then $T$ has the same evaluation on every two inputs $x,y\in\{0,1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: decision tree T on all n coordinates
inputs x and y in the Boolean cube
